title: Further restrict DNS wildcards in name constraint matching

target.summary: Evaluating permittedSubtrees using DNSConstraint::matches applies wildcard overlap semantics rather than subtree containment. Consequently, a wildcard SAN like *.example.com is wrongly permitted by a narrower constraint such as bar.example.com even though the wildcard can expand to names outside that permitted subtree.
notes: faulty call evaluating name constraints using wildcard overlap matching
implementation of the method the faulty call relies on, which implements wildcard overlap matching
